channel.description: Latest articles from Evangelical Times Limited (evangelical-times.org)

item.title: Nursing care when assisted suicide is just another treatment option
item.description: A palliative care nurse working in cancer care bravely shares her personal side of the assisted suicide debate.

item.title: Iran: Christians ‘scapegoated’ amid anti-government protests
item.description: At least ten Christians have been arrested in Iran’s south-western province of Fars, supposedly for leading anti-government protests.

item.title: Recovering the testimony of conscience
item.description: The following is an edited extract from The Road Back to God by Joe Barnard (Christian Focus Publications, 2025).

item.title: Marriage and divorce
item.description: Who would deny that the three institutions that God created – the family, the church, and the state – are under direct attack by our secular culture?

item.title: Profiting when we pray together (Part 2)
item.description: In last month’s edition of ET, I wrote the first of a two-part article considering how we may profit by meeting together to pray

item.title: The King, the cross, and the true crown
item.description: There were some things to admire in the King’s Christmas broadcast. His Majesty’s sincere desire for peace, his evident compassion for the suffering, and his personal warmth provided a calming voice in a fractured world.

item.title: Obituary: Katy Barnwell (1938–2025)
item.description: Dr Katherine ‘Katy’ Barnwell has died aged 87, after over 60 years of serving God through Wycliffe Bible Translators.

item.title: ‘Death to the Calvinists!’ The struggle to build Christ’s church in Madeira
item.description: ‘Death to the Calvinists!’ was the cry that rang out on the island of Madeira on 9 August, about the time of St Bartholomew’s Day in 1846.

item.title: Bethel, Shawn Bolz, and the battle for sufficiency
item.description: The Shawn Bolz controversy isn’t an anomaly. It exposes a movement where scripture is honoured, but not believed to be sufficient.

item.title: Are immigrants colonising our churches?
item.description: The immigration debate can be polarising, but we mustn't let it polarise our churches.
